title: Quantum Sphaera Companion: A Structure-First Mathematical Unfolding
description:
Quantum Sphaera Companion v4.10.0.

v4.10.0 continues the full-source research line of v4.9.0. Earlier layers are not rewritten; new results are appended as source layers v4.9.0-r01 to r86, and the main body is revised under a stated rule.

Revision of the main body (4.10 base). Statements of the inherited main body that later layers refuted, excluded or withdrew are archived word for word in an appendix; at their original place each keeps its number and label, with a short statement of what remains and a pointer. Known errors are corrected in the text with a status note that gives the earlier wording; reinterpreted or open statements carry a status note with the layers that decide them. Further sections consolidate states, mediators and clocks, and record field slices of the OP5 comparison model.

Layers v4.9.0-r01 to r86. Frame typing (matter, tachyon and photon frames, with a mandatory frame status in every layer from r22); the compensator as an interferometer, a 2x2 projector and a chirality projector; charges, colour, the weak isospin and the content of one generation constructed from the Dixon algebra C x H x O under named choices, anomaly-free only for left multiplication; tests of masses and mixing from the triole structure (direct routes refuted, masks fit the data without explaining them); a check of the gravitational statements and of frame-shifted constants (not supported); the integration and independent recomputation of an OP5 comparison model (an exact gauge symmetry, four hidden sixth-order conditions, formal integrability at the seed, covariance, gauge independence; the branch is closed since its background is not generated by its spinors); and a joint action W1/W2 (Einstein-Cartan, Dixon algebra with U(1), Higgs doublet) in which the tachyon part is a second reading of the same field, isotropic and stable, with the big bang as a CPT-type transition between the two readings. The field equations of W1 are derived independently with a second computer-algebra system up to the full non-linear Einstein equation.

Pre-registered tests. Tests H14 to H89 were fixed in committed notes before computation; tests whose outcome was known analytically are marked as not blind, and findings made afterwards are marked as such. Most physical readings tested are refuted or only conditionally supported; structural results hold. Pending predictions with public data dates: H15 (m_W), H42 and H46 (sin^2 theta_23).

Scope guard: this is a guarded local/restricted/effective release. Guard and residual vectors are unchanged since layer r60. It does not claim exact finite C5 zero closure, exact all-readout terminality, C6/T2 closure, a global photon-clock or Riemann-Hypothesis theorem, global all-readout closure, a physical scale, or OP5 closure. The joint action is conditional on stated author decisions and does not fix a scale.

Files. PDF (1360 pages), the TeX source flattened into one file (text identical to the modular build), the figure op5-slices-9x9.pdf, which the source expects in the same folder, and a SHA256 manifest.
